_comment: Explicit payroll-employee -> inventory item code mapping. Checked FIRST, before any automatic matching, so anything listed here is certain. Add a line whenever unmatched_employees reports someone. Names are matched case-insensitively and punctuation/spacing is ignored, so 'Luis Guerrero Soto' matches 'louis  soto'. The Xero payroll name goes on the LEFT; the inventory item code goes on the RIGHT.
